typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		Aging as string,
		Start_Date as string,
		End_Date as string,
		Case_Number as string,
		DealNumber as string,
		Specialist as string,
		Customer_Name as string,
		Customer_Type as string,
		OPICSBranch as string,
		Principal_Amount_Currency as string,
		Principal_Amount as string,
		Principal_Amount_Base as string,
		Department as string,
		Comp_Action as string,
		Status as string,
		Update_Date_Time as string,
		TotalCompAmount as string,
		Total_Comp_Amount_Base_Equi as string,
		OperatorName as string,
		As_Of_date as string,
		Comments as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(LoadDate = currentTimestamp(),
		Asofdate = iif(greaterOrEqual(length(As_Of_date),10), toDate(toString((substring(toString(As_Of_date), toInteger(1), toInteger(10))), 'MM/dd/yyyy'), "MM/dd/yyyy"), toDate(toString(null(), 'MM/dd/yyyy'), "MM/dd/yyyy"))) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn derive({Copy of Comments} = Comments,
		{Copy of Asofdate} = toString(Asofdate),
		{Copy of LoadDate} = toString(LoadDate)) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		Status as string,
		LoadDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		OperatorName as string,
		Customer_Name as string,
		Principal_Amount as string,
		Comments as string,
		DealNumber as string,
		Specialist as string,
		Case_Number as string,
		OPICSBranch as string,
		End_Date as string,
		Customer_Type as string,
		Principal_Amount_Base as string,
		Department as string,
		Total_Comp_Amount_Base_Equi as string,
		Update_Date_Time as string,
		Aging as string,
		Comp_Action as string,
		TotalCompAmount as string,
		Start_Date as string,
		As_Of_date as string,
		Principal_Amount_Currency as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Status,
		LoadDate,
		OperatorName,
		Customer_Name,
		Principal_Amount,
		Comments = {Copy of Comments},
		DealNumber,
		Specialist,
		Case_Number,
		OPICSBranch,
		End_Date,
		Customer_Type,
		Principal_Amount_Base,
		Department,
		Total_Comp_Amount_Base_Equi,
		Update_Date_Time,
		Aging,
		Comp_Action,
		TotalCompAmount,
		Start_Date,
		As_Of_date = {Copy of Asofdate},
		Principal_Amount_Currency),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
